items.q: Hepatitis that chronifies 90 percent of infected neonates but 5 percent of adults is which virus?
items.exp: Vertical transmission tolerises neonatal immunity; birth dose with immunoglobulin for e positive mothers prevents while adult infection clears mostly. C chronifies regardless of age.
items.kp: Neonatal chronicity is B: birth dose.

items.q: Lone anti HBc IgM with negative HBsAg and anti HBs means what?
o: Window period of acute HBV clearing
items.exp: Surface antigen cleared before surface antibody rises leaving core IgM solo; DNA with follow up serology confirms while vaccination shows anti HBs alone. Occult infection needs DNA.
r: Incorrect. Vaccine is anti HBs solo.
items.kp: Solo core IgM is the window.

items.q: HBeAg positivity with high HBV DNA means what and treated how?
o: Replicative infectivity needing tenofovir or entecavir
items.exp: e antigen marks wild replication with vertical and sexual risk; nucleos(t)ides suppress durably while flares and fibrosis stage urgency. Seroconversion to anti HBe calms.
items.kp: e positive high DNA: suppress now.

items.q: Immunosuppression planned in HBsAg positive lymphoma needs which HBV step?
o: Pre emptive entecavir with DNA watched as reactivation kills
items.exp: Rituximab wakes cccDNA into fulminant flares; prophylaxis through immune reconstitution prevents while tenofovir suits. Vaccine never treats carriers.
items.kp: Chemo in carriers: cover HBV first.

items.q: Genotype 3 HCV with compensated cirrhosis is cured how and followed how?
o: Sofosbuvir with velpatasvir 12 weeks then lifelong HCC surveillance
items.exp: Pangenotypic DAAs clear over 95 percent with ribavirin added in decompensation; cured cirrhosis still breeds HCC needing 6 monthly imaging. Genotype guides duration minimally now.
items.kp: C cures in weeks, liver watches for years.

items.q: Palpable purpura with HCV positivity suggests cryoglobulinaemia; cure does what?
o: DAA cure resolving vasculitis with rituximab for severe flares
items.exp: Immune complexes clear as viraemia falls; severe renal or neuropathic flares need rituximab bridging. Steroids alone relapse unfixed.
items.kp: HCV purpura: cure virus, calm vessels.

items.q: Severe flare in a chronic HBV carrier after HDV exposure is which pattern?
o: Superinfection rapidly cirrhosing needing interferon debates
items.exp: Defective delta atop established B accelerates failure; HDV RNA with anti HDV confirms while HBV suppression indirectly helps. Coinfection together stays milder.

items.q: Needlestick from HBsAg positive source in an unvaccinated worker needs what?
o: Hepatitis B immunoglobulin plus vaccine series promptly
items.exp: Passive active prophylaxis within 24 hours aborts establishment; titre checked while source DNA stratifies. Antivirals treat established, not exposed.

items.q: Cured HCV cirrhosis still needs 6 monthly ultrasound because of what?
o: Residual HCC risk persisting after SVR
items.exp: Epigenetic field cancerisation outlives virus; AFP with imaging catches curable nodules while alcohol abstinence helps. Reinfection watched separately.
items.kp: Cured but cirrhotic: still image twice yearly.

items.q: Dane particle with HBsAg, HBcAg and HBeAg describes which virion?
o: Complete HBV virion distinguishing infectivity markers
items.exp: 42 nm infectious spheres carry core with e secreted; subviral spheres and filaments (HBsAg only) outnumber. Antigen map guides serology.
